name: NATS / JetStream

evidence.jobs: C02: primary type is jobs, queues and events; J03: unacknowledged messages are redelivered
evidence.kv: C07: JetStream key-value buckets are a built-in feature
evidence.files: C07: JetStream object stores are a built-in feature

line: Durable message broker with queues, key-value stores, and object storage.

free.text: Personal: 5GiB storage, 10GiB network; inactive free teams may be deleted

sql.math: 1 GiB of data and 5 GB of transfer fit within 5 GiB of storage and 10 GiB of network. Whether connections and throughput fit is not guaranteed.
The Personal plan is free. Synadia may delete a team it considers inactive, and the inactivity period is not published.

files.math: 100 GB is more than the Pro plan's 50 GiB of Standard storage. Enterprise storage and price are custom.

jobs.math: The $49 a month Starter plan includes one container service, but CPU, RAM, runtime and workload capacity are not published.
